# Review #374 — revise
Reviewed proposal SHA256: `3c416ffd57ac6d8c9ddf2bfa6b147649e522aec863112f1630b12a6e8009291f` (verified), at checkout `1350bb56f165bed96caca69455774dde4d1ee3d7`; staged manifest checkout is `4a1797ce7070f393a4e27eb12cddb97249e90488`. Their diff only deletes an unrelated JSON record, so this is a review of the pinned proposal, not a product-change diff.
Reviewer: OpenAI GPT (Codex, gpt-6.1-sol); startup records an earlier Claude segment. Author #359 mainly used OpenAI GPT; this continuation supplies no model-family diversity claim.
## Standards
No documented naming, duplication or abstraction violations found in the report-only scope; no repository files were edited. No AGENTS.md was found.
## Spec
1. **Blocking: unresolved declaration targets.** [Proposal](../policy/proposals/lineage-pilot-359.json) decisions candidate-0124 and candidate-0227 cite artifact-0756/0787 line 88 and artifact-0746/0777 lines 14/8. All four XML URLs, resolved relative to their containing member paths, target absent archive members. Identical declared names and matching layout support a conservative suspicion, but do not independently establish the asserted membership chain to artifact-0754/0785. Supply a verified relocation/resolution mapping or provenance; until then label both overlapping decisions R3 together.
2. **Blocking: missing inventory pin.** The proposal contains only `rules` and `decisions`, with no cited inventory SHA256. Current [inventory](../benchmark/lineage.json) hashes to `52f3d2eafcbbda6695e30fb73d3a8b4f6f891b13acaf129d4ea1b091ad83d077`; its equality to the author's claimed pin cannot be verified from this export, and the history manifest has zero records. Attach the author's pin or explicitly repin and recheck the proposal.
Exact coverage passes: selecting candidate_variants by reason `different-recorded-save-versions` yields exactly the 13 proposed IDs; every decision covers its complete member set, without extras.
Independent prepared-original checks support candidate-0071/0072/0095/0108/0154: all ten hashes, pinned repository commits, fixture-relative paths and LVSR bytes at offset 36 match the cited 23/26 versions. Harness VI hashes and LVSR bytes at offset 84 also match, but do not resolve finding 1.
The six R3 groups remain unresolved: candidate-0003/0007/0035/0036/0120/0172. Their inventory metadata and member coverage match; no independent-origin conclusion is warranted. No case/result bodies or repeated 69-artifact measurement were used.
R1–R3 can guide further manual public triage after these corrections: retain R1's conservative meaning, require resolvable evidence, and preserve R2's rejection of hash/version/owner differences as independence and R3's overlap consistency.
[Lineage constraints](../benchmark/lineage.md) and [protocol §split](../benchmark/protocol.md) still require whole projects, dependencies, history and derivatives to remain development material; these pilot labels cannot subdivide repository envelopes or allocate evaluation partitions.
Required `python3 -I -B policy/evaluator/evaluate.py --check` passed: 62 evidence references, no errors; benchmark_executed=false, benchmark_ready=false, tool_quality=null. This validates the index, not substantive lineage or quality.
## What next
Policymaker: correct the two overlapping decisions or provide resolution evidence, restore the inventory pin, then request a bounded recheck of those changes. Saved verification above need not be repeated absent changed inputs; do not restart inventory measurement.
Permit additional manually evidenced public triage only, with unresolved overlap visible; do not authorize automatic decisions for unexamined groups. Native ownership, structural comparison, split isolation and benchmark quality remain unverified; machine timings do not measure substantive review throughput. This review grants no merge, readiness or goal-completion approval.

No changes to merge.
